scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm -r --parallel --no-bail --if-present --filter './packages/**' --filter '!integration-tests' test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter integration-tests test
scripts.bench:typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter benchmarks bench:typecheck
scripts.api:docs: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run api:docs:verify
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run api:docs:verify && pnpm run test
scripts.check:verify: pnpm run lint:verify && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run api:docs:verify && pnpm run test
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter content dev
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter content build
scripts.docs:preview: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter content preview
